payload.rebuttal: argued: The probe mutates saffron/draft.py:239, a file outside this spec's touches. My draft-shaped case seeds its two rows with ledger.record_spec_text directly, origin="draft" then origin="revision", the same way every other case in this file seeds a spec_texts row, never by calling saffron.draft. So no edit to that call site can reach anything my test executes, and the witness cannot be expected to notice it. The criterion's phrase "the shape saffron draft writes" explains why the fixture mixes draft then revision, so the test data is realistic; it does not ask this witness to re-verify saffron/draft.py's own writer. That guard already exists: the probe's own report shows two tests/test_draft.py tests failed under this same mutation. Making tests/test_regate.py sensitive to saffron/draft.py's internals would mean importing and exercising that module from here, which touches does not permit and the spec's own out-of-scope note (drawn the same way for saffron/task.py) does not ask for. I made no change for this finding.
